description.value: Alchemy Bar and Kitchen is a lively Italian-inspired restaurant and bar located in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, serving pizza, pasta, and globally-influenced cuisine alongside cocktails and mocktails. The restaurant has been recognized as a Rising Stars pick by Restaurant Guru 2024, and is known for its attentive service and creative menu. Its Yaletown location puts it within easy reach of the Seawall cycling route, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists exploring the area.
